# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "V2005 infinite_type"
description: "Inference would need a type that contains itself (the occurs check failed)."
---

An error from the `type` phase. `sakura explain V2005` prints this explanation offline.

Inference would need a type that contains itself (the occurs check failed). Usually a function
was applied to itself or a value was put inside its own list; add an annotation to find where.

Wrong:

```sakura
let _ = fn(x) { x(x) }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
let _ = fn(x: Int) { x }
```
